items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And another thing that Max Gordon at the Vanguard.

ctx.x: And another thing that Max Gordon at the Vanguard. Zutty changed his clientele altogether until he had such fancy trade until Zutty told him to put some table clothes on. Because it was a joint.
No table cloths, and Zutty said to him you have to put some table cloths on, fix the place up. All these fine people coming in you know.
